row.statement: The actual concrete session transition suppresses cancelled reply publication, preserves source and borrowing authority through Flush, and consumes an exact retained request receipt once. Reused tags and reused physical slots remain distinct. The mounted source is released only after bounded quiescence and actual generation return.

row.title: Actual owned 9P connection transport retains custody through bounded input and reply return
row.statement: The actual fn-ninep-transport-step reads its concrete owned cursor, decodes only observed header/body bytes, bounds each receive by its internally provisioned input quantum, and preserves mounted source custody. Version reset drains actual retained requests/fids and refuses a held mount before the definite generation return. The actual reply-return subject clears the concrete buffer only in current reply phase; duplicate return is complete unchanged refusal. The complete host correspondence includes all stobjs and unchanged STATE. This is a codec/control component, not mounted article authority, native funding or a listener claim.

row.title: Actual registered mount source and bounded immutable group directory
row.statement: The actual mounted source reader returns the held registered generation publication only with its real pin and token association. New CURRENT publications do not replace the captured source. Directory enumeration borrows actual visibility buckets and advances one bucket or compares one name byte per action. SAMEPRS mount reservation and definitive return retain counter intent across actual session writes; unfinished MODE refuses admission and uncertain pin/return cannot refund. Complete host outputs include unchanged STATE. This is source/custody composition, not a qualified served mount.

row.statement: The actual stat reply emitter appends at most one concrete octet per scheduling action, keeps nested stat sizes and complete-entry directory counts, and refuses unrepresentable codec/msize/count input without truncating names. Reply-ready requires the whole retained stat body and exact concrete output length, with a complete host/STATE boundary. Source/QID authority, per-action funding and actual mounted provider composition remain separate.
